title: TradingAgentStack connector profile v1
description: What each tool of a trading MCP server can do with money, and where its order fields live. Used by TAS Guard to enforce limits and by tradingagentstack.com to rate connectors.

slug.description: Same slug as the tradingagentstack.com listing.

source.description: Where the tool list was verified (repository or docs).

verified_against.description: Exact file, commit or doc page the tool list was read from.

quote_currency.description: Currency that order values are measured in, e.g. USD. 'quote' means the symbol's quote asset (USDT for BTC/USDT).

mode.description: How to tell paper/sandbox from live money.

env.description: Environment variable of the upstream server that selects paper trading.

preview.description: For servers that answer the first order call with a preview and a confirmation token.

confirm_arg.description: Argument carrying the confirmation token; ignored when matching approvals.

result_marker.description: Text present in a preview result; previews are not counted as executed orders.

patterns.description: Regex fallbacks for tools not listed by name, checked in order.

class.description: read: no side effects. benign_write: changes nothing about money (watchlists). order: opens or adds to a position. modify: changes a live order. cancel / cancel_all: cancels orders (cancel_all can remove stop-losses). close / close_all: reduces or exits positions. leverage: changes leverage or margin mode. funds_out: withdrawals and transfers. account: account settings. raw_write: escape hatches that can call any write endpoint. other_write: any other money-relevant write.

fields.description: Argument names holding order facts. A list means: first one present wins.

multiplier.description: Contract multiplier applied to qty x price (100 for US equity options).
